66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: Khaimera's stat line was excellent: twelve kills, team-leading damage well above the jungle norm, and only three deaths. One blemish: a solo death to their carry early, one of two caught-out deaths we gave up all game. At the Mini Prime fight where the team fought two kills down, Khaimera wasn't among the credited kills or deaths; that is exactly the fight to force the jungle lead into next time.
66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.issue: 'jungle norm' misstates Khaimera's own historical baseline as a role-wide norm, and the Mini Prime line treats a kill/death-credit absence as proof he should have been there despite his own assists not being timestamped per fight
66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.rewrite: Khaimera's stat line was excellent: twelve kills, team-leading damage well above his own usual output, and only three deaths.
